randomization.counterbalance: Within each family, 12 maneuver/repetition pairs contain exactly 6 audio-on-first and 6 muted-first pairs.

blinding.pilot_material: pilot_cards contains opaque trial tokens and maneuver instructions only; do not give the operator schedule to the pilot.
blinding.family_label: Mask the app's family and profile labels with an external monitor mask/crop; launch and select the aircraft while the pilot is away from the screen.
blinding.audio_condition: Audio-on versus mute is perceptible and cannot be blinded. Keep the condition order hidden before each run and record the pilot's post-rating guess.
blinding.validity_rule: If family/profile metadata is visible to the pilot, record the exposure and classify family blinding as failed; do not describe the block as blinded.

run_controls.launch: Open the pinned Godot build with no user arguments to reach Home; the direct --quick-flight route starts airborne and is not the runway protocol.
run_controls.pilot_input: Use one calibrated Mode 2 USB transmitter/gamepad for all trials; record device, mapping, deadband, reversals and rate setting. Keyboard fallback: arrows roll/pitch, A/D rudder, S/W throttle; this is digital input and must be declared.

engine_keys.F8: set mixture to 0.85 times the profile nominal equivalence ratio
engine_keys.F9: set mixture to 1.15 times the profile nominal equivalence ratio
engine_keys.R: reset to the selected runway start
engine_keys.T: start/stop trace recording; capture the saved trace path and SHA-256

run_controls.baseline_mixture: Leave mixture at profile nominal for every A/B flight trial; F8/F9 are reserved for separately documented rich/lean diagnostic work.
run_controls.audio: Use the same Windows output device and simulator application volume at 50 percent for audio-on trials; set only this application's Volume Mixer level to 0 percent for muted trials. Keep master volume/effects fixed and hidden from the pilot. Mixer percentage is a repeatable setting, not a calibrated sound-pressure level.
run_controls.environment: In Home, explicitly choose the default field, calm/default weather, daylight, Runway start and pilot view. Keep the same overlay preset and do not enable developer overlays. Home preferences persist, so inspect and record the actual settings before the first run.
run_controls.start: Choose the named aircraft and Runway in Home. The runway-start engine is warm but stopped; press F7. Reset with R between trials.

common_start_sequence: Press R to reset to the selected Runway start, set throttle to idle and press T to begin the trial trace.
Press F7, hold idle for 5 seconds, then smoothly advance throttle to full over 3 seconds and take off. Do not force a static hold; record any idle ground roll.

Climb to the safe test height selected before the session and establish level flight. On the takeoff_climb card, score this takeoff/climb; on other cards use this sequence only to reach the test height.

test_conditions.weather: calm/default; freeze and record the exact settings before the first run
test_conditions.target_height_note: Choose one safe height before the session and hold it constant; record the numeric height here.

ratings.scale: 1 to 7; 1=very poor/very dissimilar, 4=neutral or mixed, 7=very good/very similar; workload uses 1=very low and 7=very high.
ratings.sound_rating: Complete only for audio-on trials. Muted sound ratings stay null, not zero.
ratings.acceptance: Ratings are descriptive. A family passes only after the experienced pilot has no material unexplained discrepancy against its labeled real reference; use the plan's separate physical budgets and trace evidence. Do not average away a safety-relevant mismatch or force a family preference.

glow_2t.engine: O.S. MAX-55AX, product 15612, Type 40K carburetor, No.8 plug, stock Power Box silencer

aircraft_data.airframe: Jensen Stik 60 geometry; physical build identity/weight/CG must be recorded separately

fuel.note: The candidate profile treats lubricant as inert. Matching volume fractions controls blend composition but does not validate oil energy or chemistry. If the physical blend differs, record it and treat the comparison as fuel-mismatched.
